# UC-389 — Re-Verify the Payout Account After a Destination Change

## Header Info
- **Use Case ID:** UC-389
- **Title:** Re-Verify the Payout Account After a Destination Change
- **Actor:** Vendor (ACT-02) — Owner of the own store
- **Trigger:** The Owner changes the store's payout destination (bank account or mobile wallet)
- **Priority:** P1
- **Goal:** Land the new destination safely so payouts resume only after it is re-verified.
- **Preconditions:** Current account readable (`GET /store/payout-account`, API-VND-020); Owner role (API-VND-021); store scope (BR-VND-07).

## Main Scenario
1. Owner reads the account → client `GET /store/payout-account` returns `method`, masked number, `holderName`, `verifiedAt` (API-VND-020).
2. Owner submits the change → client `PUT /store/payout-account` with `{ method, bankName?, accountNumber, holderName }` (API-VND-021).
3. The full account number is write-only — it is never returned in any response (API-VND-021).
4. The change requires re-verification before payouts resume; until it completes the payout gate holds requests (API-VND-021, BR-ESC-06).
5. Owner confirms the new destination reads back masked with re-verification pending → `GET /store/payout-account` (API-VND-020).
6. After verification, `verifiedAt` is set and payout requests pass the eligibility check again (BR-ESC-06, API-WAL-011).

## Alternative Scenarios
- **A1 — No change submitted:** the existing destination and `verifiedAt` stay untouched; payouts unaffected.
- **A2 — KYC lapsed at the same time:** the gate blocks on `KYC_NOT_APPROVED` regardless of the account (BR-ESC-06, UC-388).
- **A3 — Change during an active hold:** the pending payout stays held; the new account is used only after verification and release (EC-27).

## Exception Scenarios
- **E1 — Invalid payload (missing holder/number):** → `VALIDATION_ERROR`; the stored account is unchanged (API-VND-021).
- **E2 — KYC not approved or store suspended at write time:** → `KYC_NOT_APPROVED` / `STORE_SUSPENDED`; no change applied (API-VND-021, BR-VND-04).
- **E3 — Non-owner staff attempts the change:** → denied; only the Owner manages the payout account (BR-VND-06, SEC-REQ-004).
- **E4 — Re-request before re-verification completes:** → the payout gate refuses; no payout row (BR-ESC-06).

## Postconditions
- Changed: the new destination is stored masked, pending re-verification; the old `verifiedAt` no longer vouches for it (API-VND-021).
- Unchanged on failure: the previous account remains in place with its verification intact.

## Business Rules Applied
- BR-ESC-06, BR-VND-06, BR-VND-07

## Related Requirements
- FR-014 (Escrow, Commission & Vendor Payouts)
- Cross-reference: UC-187 configures the destination for the first time; UC-388 covers KYC/suspension blockers.

## Permissions / Data / External Dependencies
- **Permissions:** Vendor Owner only; account number write-only, masked on read (SEC-REQ-004, SEC-REQ-006).
- **Data involved:** payout account row (`method`, masked number, `holderName`, `verifiedAt`), `payout` rows.
- **External dependencies:** KYC/verification review (B03); payout batch (B07).

## Acceptance Criteria
- **AC-UC389-01:** Given an Owner change, when `PUT /store/payout-account` succeeds, then the response never contains the full account number (API-VND-021).
- **AC-UC389-02:** Given a changed destination, when payouts are requested before re-verification, then the gate refuses (BR-ESC-06).
- **AC-UC389-03:** Given a non-owner staff caller, when the change is attempted, then it is denied (BR-VND-06).
- **AC-UC389-04:** Given re-verification completed, when the Owner reads the account, then `verifiedAt` is set and payout requests pass (API-VND-020, BR-ESC-06).
